Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.metaDescription: What this website collects, why, and how to request deletion.
Privacy.intro: This is the personal website of Abdalla Misbah, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It collects as little as possible. This page explains exactly what that is.
Privacy.formBody: When you send the form, it collects your name, email, inquiry type, organization (optional) and message. These are used only to reply to you. They are validated on the server and sent as an email to Abdalla's inbox through an email delivery provider (Resend), which processes them only to deliver that email and may keep a delivery record under its own retention policy. They are not stored in a database, and message contents are not written to logs.
Privacy.formFallback: If email delivery is not set up, your message is still checked on the server, then discarded without being sent or stored, and the form offers a link to send it from your own email app instead.
Privacy.abuseBody: To limit abuse, your IP address is used to count submissions per hour. It is kept only in the server's memory, not on disk, to enforce that limit, and is not linked to your message. A hidden field and a minimum fill time also filter out bots.
Privacy.retentionBody: Messages stay in Abdalla's email inbox as long as needed to reply and follow up, and are deleted on request.
Privacy.storageBody: There are no tracking or advertising cookies. NEXT_LOCALE is a session cookie that remembers your language. It is set when you switch language, or when you open a page in a language other than your browser's preferred one. theme in localStorage remembers light/dark/system and never leaves your browser.
Privacy.analyticsBody: The site uses no analytics or tracking scripts. If privacy-friendly analytics is added later, this page will be updated first.
Privacy.hostingLogs: Separately, the hosting provider may keep standard request logs (IP address, browser, page requested) for security and operations.
Privacy.rightsBody: To ask what Abdalla holds about you, or to have your messages deleted, email <link>{email}</link>.
Privacy.changes: If this notice changes, the date above will be updated.

About.title: About Abdalla

story.p1: I'm a Senior Software Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with more than 15 years of experience in backend development, software architecture, and enterprise integration.
story.p2: My professional journey began in software and embedded systems engineering and expanded into enterprise platforms, telecommunications, fintech, and digital banking.
story.p3: Today, I focus primarily on Java and Spring Boot, microservices, payment integrations, and event-driven architectures. I enjoy working across the full engineering lifecycle, from understanding business requirements and defining API contracts to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying reliable backend services.
story.p4: I have also led engineering teams, reviewed architectures, mentored developers, and worked with product owners, platform engineers, security teams, and external technology providers.
story.p5: My engineering philosophy is to solve the right problem with the appropriate level of complexity: prioritize clarity, reliability, maintainability, and effective collaboration over unnecessary abstraction.

right.title: Solve the right problem
right.body: Start from the business requirement and the API contract before choosing a design.

complexity.title: Appropriate complexity
complexity.body: Prefer clarity and maintainability over unnecessary abstraction.

reliability.title: Reliability through collaboration
reliability.body: Reliable services come from clear contracts, careful testing, and close work with every team involved.
